domain_title: Data, privacy, confidentiality and intellectual property
title: Purpose limitation and data minimization
canonical_definition: Only data demonstrably necessary and proportionate for the declared purpose and lifecycle stage are processed and retained.

conditions: All systems processing organizational, personal, customer or third-party information.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Is necessity defined for each material data category, field and retention period?
Are minimization, abstraction, tokenization, synthetic-data and deletion controls implemented in every relevant store and interface?
Do tests and operational evidence show that unnecessary content is excluded and deletion or scope changes propagate?

conditions: Refer a material failure of purpose limitation and data minimization to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 1.6 (PDF p. 31), MEASURE 2.10 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on deriving system requirements from context and examining privacy risk. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make purpose limitation and data minimization verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: B2 evaluates purpose limitation and data minimization using evidence from intent through operation. AP-B2 independently assesses evidence of convenience-driven data accumulation.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies field-level necessity and retention decisions for every material purpose, with approved exceptions and expiry. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates allowlisted payloads, redaction or abstraction, retention controls and propagation of deletion across stores and derived copies. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides observed minimal payloads and a scoped deletion exercise tracing primary records, indexes, caches, backups and provider boundaries. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in purpose limitation and data minimization, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide field-level necessity and retention decisions for every material purpose, with approved exceptions and expiry. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate allowlisted payloads, redaction or abstraction, retention controls and propagation of deletion across stores and derived copies. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide observed minimal payloads and a scoped deletion exercise tracing primary records, indexes, caches, backups and provider boundaries. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how purpose limitation and data minimization works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with field-level necessity and retention decisions for every material purpose, with approved exceptions and expiry. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use observed minimal payloads and a scoped deletion exercise tracing primary records, indexes, caches, backups and provider boundaries to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A justified scoped and time-limited exception within the authorized purpose is distinguishable from accumulation by default.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-B2 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in purpose limitation and data minimization
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in purpose limitation and data minimization
Evidence remains insufficient for purpose limitation and data minimization in the assessed scope
